title: Say Subol ed Silong na Buer
intro: Diad saray annals na Quran, sakey a too ya walaan na baleg ya anos so akaarap ed sakey a subok ya mamaermen ed saray sankabiskegan a kapusoan. Naandi so amin - kayamanan, pamilya, tan bunigas. Balet manlapud kaaraleman na inkaandi-ilalo, say mapaabeban pikakasi so naebatan ed ag-iilaloan a paraan. Nabidbir mo kasi yan kamarerwa ya say istorya na kipawil to et naulit ed inlabas na saray panaon?
clues: Siak so asubok ed sakey a subok a grabe a nanonotan ed amin a panaon.
Naandi so amin ya importante - say kayamanan ko, saray anak ko, tan say bunigas ko.
Say laman ko et asakbongan na ansakisakit iran sugat, tan siak so pinaliisan na amin.
Diad inkadesperado ko, tinmawag ak ed si Allah, ya inkuan kon diniwit ak nen Satanas na kairapan tan irap.
Inebatan ak nen Allah tan ingganggan to ak ya tupaken koy dalin panamegley na salik.
Manlapud saman a mismon pasen, pinmaway so ambetel a subol, tan impawil nen Allah so pamilyak tan dinoble to ra bilang panangasi.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
